title: Winco Fireworks Recalls Black Cat Cone Fountains Due to Fire Hazard
summary: When ignited, the device can burst and spread sparks and pyrotechnic materials outward instead of upward as intended, posing fire and burn hazards to bystanders. Units: About 14,000.

title: Crosman Recalls Crossbow Rope Cocking Devices Due to Injury Hazard
summary: Tabs on the hooks attaching the rope cocking device to the crossbow string can bind as the device is pulled back, causing the hooks to break and the rope to recoil, posing a risk of injury, including laceration. Units: About 1,400.

title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls Commuter Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle's fork axle can crack, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,100 (in addition, about 400 were sold in Canada).

title: Lorex Recalls Video Baby Monitors Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The video monitor's batteries can overheat, swell and expand and cause the battery cover to open or come off. This can expose hot batteries, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 26,000 (in addition, 8,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Nu Skin Recalls Mist Diffusers Due to Risk of Mold Exposure (Recall Alert)
summary: Mold can develop on the product, posing a health risk to individuals with compromised immune systems, damaged lungs or an allergy to mold. Units: About 44,000 (in addition, about 4,800 were sold in Canada and 400 were sold in Mexico).

title: GSI Outdoors Recalls Children’s Water Bottles Due to Violation of Lead Standard; Sold Exclusively at L.L.Bean
summary: The lead solder at the exterior base of the bottle contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 6,700.

title: Things Remembered Recalls Children's Jewelry Due to Violation of Lead Standard
summary: The clear surface coating on the bracelets and necklaces contain lead in excess of the allowable limit. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 6,700 bracelets and 3,300 necklaces (in addition, 300 bracelets and 100 necklaces sold in Canada).

title: Nestlé Waters North America Recalls AccuPure Water Dispensers Due to Fire and Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The water dispensers can overheat, causing internal parts to melt and smoke. This poses burn and fire hazards. Units: About 10,900.

title: Flushmate Expands Recall of Flushmate III Pressure-Assisted Flushing Systems Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards
summary: The system can burst at or near the vessel weld seam releasing stored pressure. This pressure can lift the tank lid and shatter the tank, posing impact and laceration hazards to consumers and property damage. title: Home Source Recalls Floor Lamps Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The lamps can short circuit due to defective sockets, posing fire and shock hazards. Units: About 2,700.

title: IKEA Recalls Safety Gates and Safety Gate Extensions Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The locking mechanism can open unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to children and other consumers. Units: About 80,000 (in addition, about 28,000 were sold in Canada). The PATRULL KLÄMMA safety gates were previously recalled in May 2015..

title: Three Types of Liquid Plumr Clog Removers Recalled by The Clorox Company Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: The recalled bottles are not child-resistant and children can remove the top, posing a risk of chemical burns and irritation to the skin and eyes. These products contain sodium hydroxide which is required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act to be sealed with child-resistant packaging. Units: Abou

title: Bernhardt Recalls Dressers and Nightstands Due to Serious Tip-Over Hazard
summary: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not properly anchored to the wall, posing a serious tip-over and entrapment hazard that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 1,700.

title: John Deere Recalls High-Performance Gator Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel hose could leak or separate when the fuel system is pressurized, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 240.

title: Lekker Recalls Patriot Power Generators Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively Online at 4Patriots.com
summary: The battery sold with the generator can catch fire, posing a fire hazard to the user or bystanders. Units: About 2,200.

title: Oven Mitts Recalled by Loot Crate Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The oven mitts lack thermal protection, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 360,000 (in addition, about 15,000 were sold in Canada and about 380 were sold in Mexico).

title: STUBAI Recalls Ice Axes Due to Laceration and Impact Hazards
summary: The knife in the axe handle can detach, posing a laceration or impact hazard to the user or bystanders. Units: About 20.

title: Emson Recalls UComfy Heat Wraps Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The heat wrap can overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 10,000.

title: Novel Laboratories Recalls Zolpidem Tartrate Blister Packs Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The packaging for the prescription drug is not child-resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act, posing a risk of poisoning if swallowed by children. Units: About 5,700 boxes of 30 blister packs.

title: Frigidaire and Kenmore Wall Ovens Recalled by Electrolux Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The thermal switch on the ovens can malfunction due to improper manufacturing, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,000.

title: Inovonics Recalls Pendants, Universal Transmitters and Receivers Due to Alarm Failure (Recall Alert)
summary: The transmitters and receivers can fail to send or receive a signal for help in an emergency. Units: About 5,500.

title: Smocked Threads by Cecil & Lou Recalls Children's Nightgowns Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The nightgowns fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 65.
